catalyst_rows.raw_text: SPINRAZA High Dose Regimen approved in the U.S. by the FDA following approvals in Japan and E.U.

Litifilimab second positive Phase 2 CLE dataset showed meaningful reduction of disease activity in people living with CLE at Week 16; if approved litifilimab could be the first targeted therapy for this disease.

catalyst_rows.indication: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in children with suboptimal response to prior gene therapy
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Salanersen additional Phase 1b data showed unprecedented new motor milestones achieved in children with SMA who had suboptimal clinical status despite prior administration of gene therapy.

catalyst_rows.indication: IgA nephropathy (IgAN) - Greater China region rights
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Nephrology franchise further enhanced by agreement with TJ Biopharma to acquire exclusive rights to felzartamab in the Greater China region, potentially one of the largest patient populations globally for IgAN.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Big-pharma earnings PR. Q1 2026 events: SPINRAZA HD US approval (post-FDA decision), litifilimab CLE Phase 2 second positive readout, salanersen Phase 1b SMA data, and TJ Biopharma felzartamab China deal. The pending Apellis acquisition (announced March 31, 2026) is corporate, not a single clinical milestone, so omitted from catalyst_rows.
